summary: Verified backend auth/organs APIs and mobile web preview flows: auth validation/login, guest gallery, search, organ details, lungs model fallback, and session restoration.
action_items: Consider adding testID attributes to the remaining interactive controls (login/signup toggle, guest, search, organ cards, back, launch, and model CTA) for reliable regression automation.

Confirm the deployment environment's expected backend variable naming: api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the requested configuration names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present.
critical_code_review_comments: No API mocks, 500 responses, red screen, or broken core flow observed.
Expo logs show non-blocking deprecated shadow* and Image resizeMode warnings.
Most interactive React Native elements lack testID attributes, reducing automation coverage but not blocking manual interaction.
seed_data_creation: Used the existing qa.anatomy@example.com account; no new seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview tested at mobile viewport 375x667. Login, GET /api/auth/me, guest entry, four-organ gallery, search, lungs detail, web fallback, external model CTA, and reload session persistence passed.
rca_of_issue: No functional issue reproduced. The only risks are testability (missing testIDs) and a configuration naming mismatch between the stated EXPO_BACKEND_URL requirement and the implemented/present EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL variable.
